game.name: Dj Hero 2 (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: DJ Hero 2 for Xbox 360 is the second installment of the popular rhythm game that puts you behind the decks. Adding to the features of the original is the addition of a turntable/singer duo, where a second player will have to try their hand at karaoke. Players will be able to play songs ranging from Lady Gaga to The Chemicals Brothers and over 85 other artists. The title also offers the chance to play as famous DJs such as DJ Shadow, David Guetta and Wu-Tang Clan.
